target: Experimental memory-atoms-v1 sidecar contract and explicit preview CLI
primary_semantics: Add source-bound typed memory projections without modifying summary-v1, raw history, or any live runtime path.
invariants: Raw records and summary-v1 remain byte unchanged.
Every atom and relation cites only source IDs from one validated closed Level-1 job.
Source, atom, relation, scene, and projection identities are deterministically recomputable.
Sidecar persistence is append-only, idempotent for identical bytes, and outside the archive root.
No model, network, scheduler, retrieval, federation, cloud, or dashboard path is activated.
allowed_changes: Add a strict candidate schema and extraction prompt.
Add a deterministic validator, projector, external sidecar writer, and A/B count report.
Register the new production script to the existing Memory Plane owner.
Add focused tests and an experimental contract document.
prohibited_changes: Do not modify existing raw or summary formats.
Do not add a maintenance worker, automatic model call, retrieval route, or cloud exchange route.
Do not infer priority, importance, persona, motivation, or implicit supersession.
Do not update, delete, or overwrite a prior sidecar.
before_after_checks: Hash a summary-v1 file before and after sidecar creation.
Run the real CLI with multilingual and special-character paths.
Reject source drift, unknown IDs, malformed UTF-8, invalid status/type pairs, and internal tampering.
Run the module architecture and documentation contracts.
